name: Goa
summary: India's smallest state by area. Liberated from Portuguese colonial rule on 19 December 1961 (Operation Vijay). World-renowned for beaches, churches, and cashew feni.
festivals: Goa Carnival, Shigmo, Feast of St. Francis Xavier, Sao Joao
monuments: Basilica of Bom Jesus (UNESCO Site), Se Cathedral, Aguada Fort, Chapora Fort, Dudhsagar Falls
nationalParks: Bhagwan Mahaveer Sanctuary & Mollem National Park, Salim Ali Bird Sanctuary
schemes: Griha Adhar Scheme, Mukhyamantri Devdarshan Yatra, Dayanand Social Security Scheme

mcqs.q: On which date did the Indian Armed Forces liberate Goa from Portuguese rule via Operation Vijay?
mcqs.exp: Operation Vijay was conducted on 18-19 December 1961, ending 451 years of Portuguese rule in Goa.

mcqs.q: The mortal remains of which saint are preserved in the Basilica of Bom Jesus in Old Goa?
mcqs.exp: The Basilica of Bom Jesus, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, contains the sacred relics of St. Francis Xavier.

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Goa.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Panaji. Goa covers a geographic area of 3,702 sq km across 2 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Mandovi, Zuari, Chapora, Terekhol, Sal.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: India's smallest state by area. Liberated from Portuguese colonial rule on 19 December 1961 (Operation Vijay). World-renowned for beaches, churches, and cashew feni.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Goa.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Goa was formally instituted on 30 May 1987. Official language(s): Konkani.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Fugdi, Dhalo, Dekhnni, Kunbi.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Goa Carnival, Shigmo, Feast of St. Francis Xavier, Sao Joao.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Goa.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is P. S. Sreedharan Pillai.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Goa is Pramod Sawant.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under Bombay High Court (Panaji Bench).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Gaur | State Bird: Flame-throated bulbul | State Flower: Jasmine | State Tree: Matti.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Goa.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Iron Ore, Manganese, Bauxite.

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Goa plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Goa.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Basilica of Bom Jesus (UNESCO Site), Se Cathedral, Aguada Fort, Chapora Fort, Dudhsagar Falls.

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Bhagwan Mahaveer Sanctuary & Mollem National Park, Salim Ali Bird Sanctuary.

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Goa.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Griha Adhar Scheme, Mukhyamantri Devdarshan Yatra, Dayanand Social Security Scheme.
